rows.userMessage: Your card was declined. Please try a different card or contact your bank.
rows.developerHint: Read declineCode for the issuer reason. Do not retry the same card automatically; offer another method.

rows.meaning: The issuer refused the card for lack of funds.
rows.userMessage: Your card does not have enough funds for this payment. Please try a different card.
rows.developerHint: A decline sub-case. Offer another payment method rather than retrying.

rows.meaning: The card or wallet details were rejected as invalid before authorisation.
rows.userMessage: Those payment details could not be used. Please check them and try again.
rows.developerHint: The customer can correct this in the sheet. If it repeats for every customer, check the intent and the enabled methods.

rows.meaning: The 3-D Secure challenge was not passed.
rows.userMessage: We could not verify this payment with your bank. Please try again or use a different card.
rows.developerHint: The challenge ran and the server rejected the outcome. Never infer this from the WebView URL; the server is the source of truth.

rows.meaning: The payment was cancelled — surfaced as an error only when the native reports it as one.
rows.developerHint: Most cancellations arrive as kind "canceled" with a reason. Treat this code the same way: nothing was charged.

rows.meaning: The merchant auth token was missing, blank, rejected, or your tokenProvider did not answer in time.
rows.userMessage: We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment.
rows.developerHint: Your tokenProvider threw, returned a blank authToken, or did not settle within the native 10 s budget. Check your token endpoint and clientId.

rows.meaning: The SDK was asked to do something it cannot do with the given configuration.
rows.userMessage: We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment.
rows.developerHint: A programmer error: a bad field, a sheet already presented, no foreground Activity / presenting view controller, or an option the platform does not support yet. The developer message names the field.

rows.meaning: A payment was requested before init() completed.
rows.userMessage: We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment.
rows.developerHint: Await init() before presentPaymentSheet(). On iOS this code is derived by the bridge; the Android native emits it directly.

rows.meaning: The gateway rejected the request as malformed or unknown (HTTP 400, 404 or 422).
rows.userMessage: We could not start this payment. Please try again in a moment.
rows.developerHint: Strictly 400/404/422. Usually a bad paymentIntentId, an intent that belongs to another merchant, or a method the intent does not allow. Other definitive 4xx arrive as "unknown"; on iOS httpStatus carries the status, on Android it is absent.

rows.meaning: The device could not reach the gateway.
rows.userMessage: We could not reach the payment service. Please check your connection and try again.
rows.developerHint: Transport-level failure before the request was accepted. Safe to offer a retry; the natives replay with the same idempotency key.

rows.meaning: The native exhausted its attempt budget, or the confirm left the device and no answer came back.
rows.userMessage: This payment is taking longer than expected. We will confirm it shortly — please do not pay again.
rows.developerHint: Outcome unknown: the payment may still succeed. Arrives as the cause of a pending result. Reconcile from your server or via pending.reconcile(); never present again as a new payment.

rows.meaning: The gateway answered 5xx or 429 while the intent was being loaded.
rows.userMessage: The payment service is having trouble right now. Please try again in a moment.
rows.developerHint: Load-path only. A 5xx on the confirm path is reported as pending + timeout instead, because the outcome is unknown there. On iOS this code is derived from the message when a status can be recovered.

rows.meaning: The intent is already in a terminal state and can no longer be paid.
rows.userMessage: This payment can no longer be completed.
rows.developerHint: The terminal-intent guard refused before any form was shown. A SUCCEEDED / REQUIRES_CAPTURE intent resolves completed and a CANCELLED one resolves canceled, so this code means FAILED. Create a new intent.

rows.meaning: A code neither bridge recognises. The raw native value is preserved in error.raw.
rows.userMessage: Something went wrong with this payment. Please try again or use a different method.
rows.developerHint: Report error.raw and error.httpStatus (iOS only; Android does not expose it) to UQPAY. Never report the payment as completed. This is the definitive no-failure-code fallback on both natives, so the outcome is known unless the per-occurrence isOutcomeUnknown flag says otherwise.
